title: Packet correlation IDs through RX/TX pipeline
description: No packet ID or trace ID is threaded through the processing pipeline (link → SCHC → IPv6 → routing → CoAP) in any implementation. An AI reconstructs connections from timestamps and sizes. Fix: assign a monotonic packet ID at RX entry and propagate through processing stages. Include in all log messages. Python: add to LinkLayer.receive() return. Rust: add to authenticated frame struct. C: add to work handler context or net_pkt user data. Single highest-leverage diagnosability improvement.
